0.text: What do you want, outsider? Folk like you shouldn’t be here. Don’t belong here. It’s not your place...
I'm here about the poisoned water.
Ain't no poisoned water! What’s happening to Kingsport Lake’s a gift from the dead lord!

1.text: You got a real nerve coming here and disrespectin’ our customs outsider. Real nerve. I’d watch my back if I were you.
